q-23778.text: Parking is prohibited at fuel stations, up to 5 metres before and after, even when the stations are closed

q-23781.text: Parking within 15 metres of the bus stop sign, if the stopping areas are not marked out, results, among other things, in the deduction of licence points

q-23782.text: Parking in the spaces reserved for the stopping and parking of vehicles for disabled people results, among other things, in the deduction of licence points

q-23783.text: Parking at the ramps or links between pavements and carriageway used by vehicles for disabled people results, among other things, in the deduction of licence points

q-23784.text: Parking in lanes or carriageways reserved for public transport vehicles results, among other things, in the deduction of licence points

q-23785.text: Parking in the spaces reserved for the standing and stopping of buses, trolleybuses and rail vehicles is permitted if a parking disc is used

q-23786.text: Parking within 15 metres of the bus stop sign, if the standing areas are not marked out, is permitted by using the hazard warning lights (four indicators flashing simultaneously)

q-23787.text: Parking in the spaces reserved for the stopping and parking of vehicles for disabled people results in a fine, but not in the deduction of points from the driver's licence

q-23788.text: Parking at the ramps or links between pavements and carriageway used by vehicles for disabled people results in suspension of the driving licence

q-23789.text: Parking in lanes or carriageways reserved for public transport vehicles is permitted, in built-up areas, from 22.00 to 8.00

q-23790.text: Emergency parking is the interruption of travel when the vehicle is unusable because of a breakdown

q-23791.text: Emergency parking is the interruption of travel when the vehicle must halt because of physical illness of the driver or a passenger

q-23792.text: Emergency parking is the interruption of travel due to traffic requirements

q-23793.text: Emergency parking is the temporary suspension of travel to allow a disabled person to get off

q-23794.text: Emergency parking is the temporary suspension of travel to allow a disabled person to get into the vehicle

q-23795.text: When opening the doors of a vehicle, you must make sure that this does not constitute danger or obstruction to other road users

q-23796.text: Before opening the door of a vehicle on the side facing the centre of the road, you must make sure that no other vehicles are approaching

q-23797.text: Before opening the door of a vehicle on the side facing the pavement, you must make sure that no pedestrians are approaching

q-23798.text: When getting out of a vehicle, you must make sure that this does not constitute danger or obstruction to other road users

q-23799.text: When about to get out of the motor vehicle, the driver must make sure, also by means of the rear-view mirror, that no other vehicles are approaching

q-23800.text: Before getting out of the parked vehicle, the driver must make sure the engine is switched off

q-23801.text: Opening a door of the vehicle on the pavement side requires the driver to activate the direction indicator on that side

q-23802.text: Opening the doors of the vehicle on the side facing the centre of the road is prohibited

q-23803.text: The driver may leave the parked vehicle with the engine running to allow the air conditioning to work

q-23804.text: Before getting out of the parked vehicle, the driver must apply the handbrake on all downhill roads but not on uphill ones

q-23805.text: In the case of obstruction of the carriageway due to accidental fall of the load, the driver must remove the load, if possible

q-23806.text: On an extra-urban road, in the case of obstruction of the carriageway due to accidental fall of the load, the driver must give advance warning of the obstacle with the stationary vehicle sign (triangle)

q-23807.text: In the case of obstruction of the carriageway due to accidental fall of the load, the driver must promptly clear the way for traffic, as far as possible

q-23808.text: In the case of obstruction of the carriageway due to accidental fall of the load, the driver must give advance warning of the obstacle with the STOP sign

q-23809.text: In the case of obstruction of the carriageway due to accidental fall of the load, the driver must remain on board the vehicle awaiting rescue

q-23810.text: In the case of obstruction of the carriageway due to breakdown of the vehicle, the driver must promptly clear the way for approaching traffic

q-23811.text: In the case of obstruction of the carriageway due to breakdown of the vehicle, the driver must push the vehicle off the carriageway or, if this is not possible, place it at the right edge of the carriageway

q-23812.text: In the case of obstruction of the carriageway due to fall of the load or for any other cause, the driver must remove the obstruction, as far as possible

q-23813.text: In the case of obstruction of the carriageway due to breakdown of the vehicle, the driver is not required to move it, while awaiting rescue, if traffic is light

q-23814.text: In the case of obstruction of the carriageway due to accidental fall of the load, the driver must avoid moving it so as to allow the event to be correctly reconstructed

q-23816.text: On an extra-urban road, in the case of an accident that obstructs the carriageway because of damaged vehicles that cannot be removed, the driver or passengers must give advance warning of the area with the warning triangle

q-23817.text: In the case of obstruction of the carriageway due to breakdown of a vehicle that cannot be moved, the driver must inform the police, without having to give advance warning of the area.

q-23818.text: In the case of obstruction of the carriageway due to a fallen load that cannot be removed, the driver may omit to inform the police if he gives advance warning of the area with effective hand signals

q-23819.text: Anyone who has been unable to prevent the fall or spillage of slippery, flammable or otherwise dangerous materials must, among other things, give advance warning of the area with the warning triangle, even in the middle of the carriageway

q-23820.text: On an extra-urban road, anyone who has been unable to prevent the fall or spillage of slippery, flammable or otherwise dangerous materials must, among other things, give advance warning of the area with the warning triangle placed even in the middle of the carriageway

q-23821.text: Anyone who has been unable to prevent the fall or spillage of dangerous materials must, among other things, make hand signals to stop vehicles passing on the side where the warning triangle has not been placed

q-23822.text: Anyone who has been unable to prevent the fall or spillage of slippery, flammable or dangerous materials must, among other things, remove them or spread on the ground, if possible, sand, soil, sawdust or other suitable material to restore grip

q-23823.text: Anyone who has been unable to prevent the fall or spillage of dangerous materials must, among other things, make hand signals to indicate the danger, only on the side where the warning triangle has been placed

q-23824.text: The driver of a motor vehicle who has been unable to prevent the spillage of dangerous materials may omit to give advance warning of the area with the warning triangle if he makes sound signals to keep other vehicles away

q-23826.text: Outside built-up areas, at night, when the rear position lights or hazard lights are missing or insufficient, it is compulsory to give advance warning of the vehicle, stationary on the carriageway, with the warning triangle

q-23827.text: Outside built-up areas, at night, it is compulsory to give advance warning with the warning triangle of any load accidentally fallen from the vehicle onto the carriageway

q-23828.text: Outside built-up areas, it is compulsory, even by day, to give advance warning of a vehicle stationary on the carriageway with the warning triangle when it cannot be clearly seen at 100 metres' distance

q-23829.text: Outside built-up areas it is compulsory, even by day, to give advance warning of a load accidentally fallen on the carriageway with the warning triangle, when the obstruction cannot be clearly seen at 100 metres' distance

q-23830.text: The warning triangle is part of the compulsory equipment of motor vehicles

q-23831.text: The warning triangle must be placed behind the vehicle or the obstacle to be signalled, at least 50 metres away

q-23832.text: In the case of an intersection at a distance of less than 50 metres, the warning triangle must be placed behind the vehicle in the position most suitable to be seen

q-23833.text: The warning triangle must be placed on the carriageway so that it is visible at a distance of at least 100 metres from approaching vehicles

q-23836.text: Outside built-up areas, it is optional to give advance warning, even by day, of a load accidentally fallen on the carriageway with the warning sign, when it cannot be clearly seen at 100 metres' distance

q-23837.text: At night, when the rear position lights or hazard lights are missing or insufficient, it is compulsory to give advance warning of the stationary vehicle with the warning triangle, even in built-up areas

q-23838.text: At night, when the rear position lights are missing or insufficient, it is compulsory to give advance warning of stationary bicycles, mopeds and motorcycles with the warning triangle, even in built-up areas

q-23839.text: The warning triangle must be placed on the load accidentally fallen on the carriageway

q-23840.text: The warning triangle must be placed on the carriageway so that it is visible at a distance of at least 50 metres from approaching vehicles

q-23841.text: The warning triangle must be placed in the lane occupied by the stationary vehicle or the fallen load

q-23842.text: The warning triangle must be placed on the carriageway at least one metre from its outer edge

q-23843.text: In the case of a carriageway with several lanes, the warning triangle must be placed in the lane immediately to the left of the stationary vehicle or the fallen load

q-23844.text: The warning triangle must be placed on the carriageway at least one metre from the line separating the directions of travel

q-23845.text: During advance warning operations with the warning triangle, the driver must make himself visible by wearing the high-visibility retroreflective vest or braces

q-23846.text: The high-visibility retroreflective vest or braces to be used during advance warning operations with the warning triangle must be of an approved type

q-23847.text: During advance warning operations with the warning triangle, the driver must wear the high-visibility vest even if he is on emergency lanes or lay-bys

q-23848.text: To carry out advance warning operations with the warning triangle, the driver is prohibited from getting out of the vehicle and walking on the road without wearing the high-visibility vest

q-23849.text: During advance warning operations with the warning triangle, the use of the high-visibility retroreflective vest or braces is optional

q-23850.text: During advance warning operations with the warning triangle, the driver must not wear the high-visibility vest if he is on emergency lanes or lay-bys

q-23853.text: On motorways and main extra-urban roads, cars that are not able by construction to reach a speed on the flat of at least 80 km/h are prohibited from travelling

q-23854.text: On motorways and main extra-urban roads, agricultural machines are prohibited from travelling

q-23855.text: On motorways and main extra-urban roads, vehicles with a disorderly load that is not firmly secured or that projects beyond the permitted limits are prohibited from travelling

q-23856.text: On motorways and main extra-urban roads, vehicles that are not watertight and have an uncovered load are prohibited from travelling if they carry materials that may scatter

q-23857.text: On motorways and main extra-urban roads, vehicles whose condition of use, equipment and tyres may constitute a danger to traffic are prohibited from travelling

q-23858.text: On motorways and main extra-urban roads, buses carrying students are prohibited from travelling

q-23860.text: On motorways and main extra-urban roads, vehicles carrying live animals are prohibited from travelling.

q-23861.text: Mopeds that reach a speed of at least 50 km/h are allowed to travel on motorways and main extra-urban roads

q-23862.text: Agricultural machines not towing a trailer are allowed to travel on motorways and main extra-urban roads

q-23863.text: Vehicles without tyres, if secured, are allowed to travel on motorways and main extra-urban roads

q-23864.text: On motorways and main extra-urban roads, pedestrians and animals are prohibited from travelling, except in service areas and rest areas

q-23865.text: In the service areas and rest areas of motorways and main extra-urban roads, animals may move around only if properly supervised

q-23866.text: Along the emergency lanes of motorways, pedestrians may walk only to reach the emergency call points

q-23867.text: On a motorway, the towing of broken-down vehicles on carriageways, ramps, slip roads, service areas or parking areas is permitted only to authorised recovery vehicles

q-23868.text: On motorways and main extra-urban roads, pedestrians and animals are prohibited from travelling, even in service areas and rest areas

q-23869.text: In the service areas and rest areas of motorways and main extra-urban roads, animals may not move around even if properly supervised

q-23870.text: On carriageways, ramps, slip roads, service areas or parking areas and in any other motorway appurtenance, it is prohibited to ask for or give lifts

q-23871.text: In motorway service areas or parking areas and in any other motorway appurtenance, commercial activities may be carried out only if authorised by the body that owns the road

q-23872.text: On carriageways, ramps, slip roads, service areas or parking areas and in any other motorway appurtenance, camping is permitted only in the areas intended for it and for the period set by the body that owns the road

q-23873.text: In motorway service areas, the driver must not leave the vehicle parked for more than 24 hours

q-23874.text: On motorways it is permitted to give lifts to disabled people

q-23875.text: In motorway service areas or parking areas it is permitted to ask for and give lifts.

q-23876.text: In service areas or parking areas of motorways and main extra-urban roads, camping is permitted

q-23877.text: In motorway service and parking areas the maximum duration of parking for a vehicle is three hours

q-23878.text: When travelling on motorways and main extra-urban roads, the use of dipped-beam headlamps is compulsory even by day

q-23879.text: When travelling on motorways and main extra-urban roads, the use of dipped-beam headlamps is optional in conditions of perfect visibility

q-23880.text: On the carriageways, ramps and slip roads of motorways and main extra-urban roads, it is prohibited to make a U-turn and to cross the central reservation, even at the gaps

q-23881.text: On the carriageways, ramps and slip roads of motorways and main extra-urban roads, it is prohibited to travel along the carriageway or part of it in the direction opposite to the permitted one

q-23882.text: On the carriageways, ramps and slip roads of motorways and main extra-urban roads, it is prohibited to reverse

q-23884.text: On the emergency stopping lanes of motorways, it is prohibited to reverse

q-23885.text: On the carriageways, ramps and slip roads of motorways and main extra-urban roads, the driver may make a U-turn by taking all the necessary precautions

q-23886.text: On the carriageways, ramps and slip roads of motorways and main extra-urban roads, the driver may make a U-turn in cases of particular emergency

q-23887.text: On the carriageways, ramps and slip roads of motorways and main extra-urban roads, the driver may proceed against the normal flow of traffic, for short stretches

q-23888.text: On motorways and main extra-urban roads, the driver may use the emergency lane if traffic is heavy

q-23889.text: On motorways and main extra-urban roads, the driver travelling along the acceleration lane must give way to vehicles travelling in the traffic lanes

q-23890.text: On motorways and main extra-urban roads, to leave the carriageway the driver must move into the right-hand lane in good time, and then enter the deceleration lane from its start

q-23891.text: On motorways and main extra-urban roads, the driver must signal a lane change promptly using the direction indicators

q-23892.text: In the event of a traffic jam on main extra-urban roads or motorways, if the emergency lane is missing or is insufficient for the passage of police or rescue vehicles, the driver of the vehicle in the first right-hand lane must position himself as close as possible to the left-hand line

q-23893.text: In the event of a traffic jam the driver may travel on the emergency stopping lane only to leave the motorway, starting from the exit advance sign located 500 metres from the slip road

q-23894.text: On motorways and main extra-urban roads, to leave the carriageway the driver may enter the deceleration lane even in the stretch after its start

q-23895.text: On motorways and main extra-urban roads, if traffic is not heavy the driver is not obliged to use the direction indicators to signal a lane change

q-23896.text: On motorways and main extra-urban roads, travelling in parallel lines is permitted even in the absence of traffic

q-23897.text: On the carriageways, ramps and slip roads of motorways, parking is permitted only in emergency situations due to illness of the driver or passengers or to a vehicle fault

q-23898.text: On the carriageways, ramps and slip roads of motorways, in the case of illness of a passenger, it is permitted to stop on the emergency stopping lane

q-23899.text: In the case of illness of a passenger while travelling on the motorway carriageway, it is permitted to stop on the emergency stopping lane

q-23900.text: On the carriageways, ramps and slip roads of motorways, emergency parking must not exceed the strictly necessary time and in any case must not last beyond three hours

q-23901.text: On the carriageways, ramps and slip roads of motorways, it is prohibited to park or stop, in the case of illness of passengers

q-23903.text: On the carriageways, ramps and slip roads of motorways, emergency parking must not exceed the strictly necessary time and may last up to 24 hours

q-23904.text: On a motorway it is prohibited to give a lift to a motorist stranded on the emergency lane because of a vehicle breakdown

q-23905.text: If the driver sees a motorist stopped with a broken-down vehicle on a motorway, he must accompany him to the nearest service station

q-23906.text: If the driver sees a motorist stopped because of a vehicle breakdown on a motorway, he must stop to give assistance

q-23907.text: If the driver sees a motorist stopped because of a vehicle breakdown on a motorway, if he has passed him he may carefully reverse to help him

q-23908.text: If the driver sees a motorist stopped on a motorway because of a vehicle breakdown, he may carefully tow the vehicle to the first exit toll booth

q-23909.text: All passengers of motor vehicles must take their places so as not to limit the driver's freedom and not to obstruct his visibility

q-23910.text: The maximum number of seats in cars is indicated on the vehicle registration document

q-23911.text: On vehicles, the carriage of one domestic animal is permitted, in any case in such a way that it does not impede or endanger driving

q-23912.text: On vehicles, the carriage of domestic animals is permitted even in numbers greater than one, provided they are kept in a cage or in the rear compartment, specially separated by a net

q-23913.text: The number of persons that can be carried in cars indicated on the vehicle registration document does not include the driver

q-23914.text: The number of persons that can be carried in cars may reach a maximum of ten

q-23915.text: On vehicles, the carriage of dogs is permitted even in numbers greater than one, provided they are adequately restrained on a lead

q-23917.text: On motorcycles, the carriage of minors under 5 years of age is prohibited

q-23918.text: Motorcycle riders are prohibited from towing other vehicles and from being towed by them

q-23919.text: On motorcycles it is prohibited to carry objects that are not firmly secured

q-23920.text: On motorcycles it is prohibited to carry objects that impede or limit the rider's visibility

q-23921.text: On motorcycles it is possible to carry a passenger only if the latter is of legal age

q-23922.text: Motorcycles are permitted to be towed, but only by cars

q-23924.text: The load of vehicles must be arranged so as to prevent it from falling or scattering

q-23925.text: The load of vehicles must be arranged so as not to reduce the driver's visibility nor impede his freedom of movement in driving

q-23926.text: The load of vehicles must be arranged so as not to compromise the stability of the vehicle

q-23927.text: The load of vehicles must be arranged so as not to hide lighting and visual signalling devices, nor the registration plates and the signals made with the arm

q-23928.text: The load of the vehicle must be arranged so as to prevent it from falling or scattering only if the driver has to drive the vehicle on an extra-urban road

q-23929.text: The load of vehicles must be arranged so as not to hide lighting and visual signalling devices only during night-time driving

q-23930.text: The load must not exceed the profile limit set for each type of vehicle

q-23931.text: On motor vehicles, the load cannot project longitudinally from the front

q-23932.text: The load may project longitudinally from the rear, if made up of indivisible items, up to 3/10 of the length of the motor vehicle

q-23933.text: On motor vehicles, items may be carried that project laterally outside their profile by no more than 30 centimetres from the front and rear position lights (in any case within the maximum profile limits)

q-23934.text: It is prohibited to carry or tow items that drag on the ground, even if partly supported by wheels

q-23935.text: If the load projects beyond the profile of the vehicle, the driver must take all suitable precautions to avoid danger to other road users

q-23936.text: The load must be arranged on the vehicle so as to signal its rear projection with the retroreflective panel shown in the picture

q-23937.text: The load may project laterally, if made up of indivisible items, up to 3/10 of the width of the vehicle

q-23938.text: It is permitted to carry or tow items that drag on the ground if partly supported by wheels

q-23939.text: The longitudinal projection of the load, up to 3/10 of the length of the vehicle, must be signalled by one or two of the square panels shown in the picture

q-23940.text: The panel shown in the picture must be applied in every case where the load projects to the rear, even slightly

q-23941.text: The panel shown in the picture signals indivisible loads that project from the rear of the vehicle

q-23942.text: If the load projects longitudinally across the entire width of the rear of the vehicle, there must be two of the panels shown in the picture, placed transversely at the two ends of the load

q-23943.text: The longitudinal projection of the load, up to 3/10 of the length of the vehicle, must be signalled by one or two of the panels shown in the picture

q-23944.text: The panel shown in the picture signals indivisible loads that project from the rear right

q-23945.text: If the load projects longitudinally across the entire width of the rear of the vehicle, two retroreflective panels shown in the picture must be applied

q-23946.text: The orange retroreflective panel shown in the picture signals vehicles that are carrying dangerous goods

q-23947.text: The panel shown in the picture makes it easier to identify from the rear lorries with a laden mass over 3.5 tonnes

q-23948.text: The yellow panel shown in the picture placed on the rear of the trailer identifies a lorry with trailer or an articulated lorry

q-23949.text: The orange retroreflective panel shown in the picture is placed at the rear to signal dangerous projecting loads

q-23950.text: The panels shown in the picture are placed on the carriageway to signal an obstacle

q-23951.text: The panel shown in the picture must be applied to the rear of buses with a total mass over 3.5 tonnes

q-23952.text: No vehicle may tow or be towed by more than one vehicle (except in the case of exceptional transports)

q-23953.text: A motor vehicle may tow a vehicle that is not a trailer if the latter can no longer travel because of a breakdown or the lack of essential parts

q-23954.text: The towing of one vehicle by another in an emergency situation must take place by means of a solid connection, such as a rope, chain, cable or rigid bar, provided they are suitably signalled

q-23955.text: The towing of a broken-down vehicle in an imminent emergency situation must take place by means of a solid connection, provided it is suitably signalled so that the vehicles are clearly visible to other road users

q-23956.text: If, in an emergency situation, the driver tows another vehicle with his own without complying with the requirements on the solidity of the connection, he is punished with the deduction of 2 points from the driving licence

q-23957.text: On a motorway, a motor vehicle may tow a vehicle that is not a trailer, if the latter can no longer travel for any serious reason

q-23958.text: The towing of a broken-down vehicle in an imminent emergency situation must take place by means of a solid connection, even if it is not possible to signal it

q-23960.text: If, in an emergency situation, the driver tows another vehicle with his own without complying with the requirements on the solidity of the connection, he is punished with the deduction of 4 points from the driving licence

q-23961.text: The driver of a car must consider the risks on the road linked to the presence of bicycles, vehicles of modest mass characterised by low speeds and possible lateral swaying

q-23962.text: The driver of a car or motorcycle must also adapt his driving to the risks linked to the presence of bicycles in traffic

q-23963.text: The driver of a car must pay particular attention to the presence in traffic of bicycles ridden by very young and inexperienced riders or by elderly people

q-23964.text: For a cyclist who is about to make a manoeuvre, it is very difficult to judge the approach speed of the motor vehicles present in traffic

q-23965.text: The driver of a car must anticipate the difficulty of judging the speed of his own vehicle for a cyclist who, being in the same lane, is about to turn left

q-23966.text: The driver must exercise particular caution when driving in the presence of an elderly cyclist who, to check the road behind him, twists his torso with difficulty and slowness because of advanced age

q-23967.text: The presence in extra-urban traffic of children on bicycles, even side by side, does not represent a risk for those driving a motor vehicle, given their modest speed

q-23968.text: Cyclists can travel in complete safety in extra-urban traffic because drivers of motor vehicles are always able to foresee any falls or dangerous swerves of theirs due to irregularities in the road surface

q-23969.text: The approach speed of a car, especially on extra-urban roads, is easily judged from a distance by a cyclist who is proceeding slowly

q-23970.text: The driver of a car must constantly remember the risk arising from the presence in traffic of moped riders with limited driving experience because of their young age

q-23971.text: The left-turn manoeuvre is particularly dangerous for a moped, which has to cross the path of one or more columns of faster vehicles approaching in the same direction

q-23972.text: The driver of a motor vehicle must carefully assess, in relation to his own speed, the distance separating him from a moped rider who is about to turn

q-23973.text: The driver of a motor vehicle must anticipate sudden manoeuvres by others, such as a moped weaving in a zig-zag

q-23974.text: The driver of a motor vehicle or motorcycle must keep a safe lateral distance from cyclists or moped riders to avoid endangering their balance while riding

q-23975.text: The driver of a motor vehicle must avoid lateral deviations, even slight ones, of his vehicle, especially in the presence of moped riders or cyclists, to avoid the possibility of their falling to the ground

q-23976.text: The driver of a motor vehicle must comply with the traffic rules, but is not required to anticipate the possible carelessness of the moped rider alongside him on the road

q-23977.text: It is easy for the driver of a motor vehicle to judge the distance separating him from a moped rider who slows down suddenly to turn into a road that is not sufficiently signed

q-23978.text: The driver of a car may overtake a moped rider at high speed, while respecting the limits, despite the small lateral safe distance

q-23979.text: The driver of a car must be aware of the risks arising from the presence, especially on extra-urban roads, of particularly slow vehicles, such as three-wheeled mopeds

q-23980.text: For a car travelling at high speed, while respecting the limits, on a two-lane extra-urban road, a three-wheeled moped constitutes a potential danger, especially if it makes sudden manoeuvres

q-23981.text: For the driver of a car travelling at a steady speed on an extra-urban road, it may be difficult to judge the speed of an agricultural machine which, in general, proceeds slowly

q-23982.text: The presence of vehicles that can reach very different speeds from one another, especially on extra-urban roads, constitutes a safety factor

q-23983.text: It is easy to judge the time of approach to a slow vehicle for a car that, especially on extra-urban roads, travels at high speed while respecting the limits

q-23984.text: A collision between vehicles with very different masses is more dangerous

q-23985.text: When driving a small car it is necessary to assess the greater risks arising from possible rear-end collisions or collisions with a car of greater mass

q-23986.text: A car of considerable mass constitutes, in traffic, a guarantee of safety also for other vehicles of smaller size and mass

q-23987.text: Vehicles are all the safer, in traffic, the more their masses differ

q-23988.text: Large differences in performance and mass between cars promote good road safety

q-23989.text: The driver of an off-road vehicle (SUV) must drive with the utmost caution, aware that the height and mass of his vehicle constitute a potential danger for pedestrians, cyclists and cars of modest size

q-23990.text: Drivers of off-road vehicles (SUVs) must consider the serious damage that the protruding, reinforced bumpers of their vehicle can cause in the event of impact with smaller vehicles

q-23991.text: The driver of an off-road vehicle (SUV) must remember that driving this vehicle is particularly demanding in town and requires particular care, above all in emergency manoeuvres

q-23992.text: Driving an off-road vehicle (SUV), with its considerable mass and height greater than cars, guarantees maximum safety for the occupants of the vehicle itself and for other road users

q-23993.text: In the event of a collision or rear-end collision, protruding, reinforced bumpers (bull bars) make off-road vehicles less dangerous to other vehicles

q-23994.text: Driving an off-road vehicle (SUV) is particularly suitable inside built-up areas

q-23995.text: When driving a car it is advisable to constantly assess the potential danger of industrial vehicles and buses, because of their considerably greater mass

q-23996.text: The driver of a motorcycle or car must know how to assess when driving the high risks arising from lorries, lorries with trailer or articulated lorries that do not respect speed limits

q-23997.text: Lorries, lorries with trailer and articulated lorries, because of their considerable mass, do not constitute, for a car or a motorcycle, greater potential risks than any other vehicle

q-23998.text: Even though the construction characteristics of the vehicle make an adequate field of vision possible, while driving the driver must carefully scan the area in front and nearby

q-23999.text: For the driver the field of vision may be reduced both by one of the head restraints and by parts of the bodywork of his own car, which may accidentally prevent other road users from being seen

q-24000.text: To allow adequate visibility, it is prohibited to apply adhesive films on the windscreen and on the front side windows of vehicles

q-24001.text: Pedestrians and above all children risk remaining outside the field of vision of the driver of an off-road vehicle (SUV) because of the size of the vehicle

q-24002.text: The driver may limit himself to a hasty visual check of the area immediately in front of the vehicle since his vehicle has, by construction, an adequate field of vision

q-24003.text: It is permitted to apply adhesive films on the front side windows and on the windscreen, provided they are made of removable material

q-24004.text: Off-road vehicles are of a height that allows the driver adequate visibility of all possible obstacles low down (for example, children)

q-24005.text: Before resuming travel, the driver of a lorry must pay particular attention to the possible presence of a pedestrian or a cyclist in the area immediately in front of his stationary vehicle

q-24006.text: The driver of a lorry stopped at a traffic light must anticipate the presence of pedestrians and cyclists who cannot be seen because of the shape of his own vehicle

q-24007.text: The limited view offered by the windscreen of lorries in the area immediately in front of the vehicle makes it dangerous to stop such vehicles in a queue, if pedestrians or two-wheeled vehicles are present

q-31022.text: While driving, the driver must pay attention both to the road users who are in front of their vehicle and to those at the edges of the road

q-31023.text: Concentrating one's attention on the directions of the satnav can be a source of distraction while driving

q-31024.text: The driver must never overestimate their own driving ability

q-31025.text: Traffic rules are established to guarantee greater driving safety for all road users

q-31026.text: Compliance with traffic rules makes it possible to limit the risks connected with driving all vehicles, both motor vehicles and those without a motor

q-31027.text: Compliance with the rules makes it possible to limit obstruction to traffic

q-31028.text: Using a mobile phone while driving is dangerous because it reduces attention to the road

q-31029.text: Using a mobile phone while driving, even with a hands-free kit, can reduce attention to the road

q-31030.text: Distraction while driving is one of the main causes of road accidents

q-31031.text: Attention while driving decreases when you are tired

q-31032.text: Setting the satnav while driving reduces attention to the road

q-31034.text: Our senses are not able to pick up all the stimuli present in the environment

q-31036.text: Sometimes we expose ourselves to situations that are riskier than those we are able to handle

q-31037.text: The driver may take their eyes off the road when they believe there is no imminent danger of an accident

q-31038.text: Near a junction a driver may stop and, while waiting for other vehicles to pass, send a quick message with the mobile phone
